lines: The giant wasps had tumbled onto the sandy beach, their legs twitching.
Sheesh. There were some kind of larvae mixed in, has Lilim actually been raising them...?
I swept aside the fallen Devildomian Wasps with my foot and helped up Metier, who'd been trembling in their midst.
Watching from afar was the root of all evilーLilim.
I didn't know what "damn Fuma" was about, but she ran toward us as she pouted.
You again? What're you doing in a place like this?
That's my line! Don't get in the way of our sales!
You weren't doing any serious business, no matter how you look at it.
Ggh, shut up! Get frostbite and die, dumb jerk!
Lilim had thrown shaved ice at me and Aina and run off somewhere, saying, "That's revenge for the other day!"
Th-, thanks, Fuma-san... You saved me. Although Lilim got away...
Aina asked curiously as she wiped away syrup that had stuck to her face.
Yeah, this one's the Succubus Metier. And that one before is the annoying critter Lilim.
A Succubus!? This kid!? That's not what I imagined...
Metier politely bowed her head to the puzzled Aina.
Thank you for your help. I'm indebted to Fuma-san from when he captured Lilim.
Since then, we've been having Lilim sell shaved ice here as punishment for escaping.
Of course. Even Lilim wouldn't be able to escape from here, a resort that takes up an entire island.
But Succubi are sex demons, right? What're they doin' sellin' shaved ice?
Aina raised a reasonable question. Why were Succubi, demons who show men lecherous dreams, selling shaved ice on a sunny beach?
Well, about thatーit's because this is a sex demon resort.
What do you mean? Explain it to me.
Of course, at first, it was just a luxury resort run by humans.
But about half a year back, the Succubi and Incubi seduced the managers and the top brass, taking over the whole island.
The whole island...!? Why would they do something like that? To make money?
That's part of it, but also... the true goal is gathering life force.
Right, they turn the life force of men and women into sustenance.
Of course. I was starting to get the picture now.
Um, just to be clear, this "life force of men and women," does that mean...?
Ignoring the blushing Aina, Metier continued her explanation.
The Succubi and Incubi want to increase their power in the human worldー
ーbut in order for many of them to remain active, they need a lot of the male and female essence that serves as their sustenance. That's when their sights were set on this resort.
An uninhibited beach resort is the ideal situation for gathering male and female life force♪
The picture was starting to become clearer.
This was a resort with a terrible conspiracy, one with the goal of Succubi and Incubi squeezing out guests' life force.
So the attractive demons show off their charming figures at the sandy beach, work up the humans' horniness, and gobble all that deliciousness up at night.
Plus, even though something a little suspicious is going on, it won't be found out that easily, since it's a remote island that only members can enter♪
Metier gave a sweet smile as she spoke.
What the hell! This is some place we've come to!
I see!! So that's why there are so many beautiful women!
That's right. The finest selection of beautiful men and women are out on the beach to ripen that delicious life force.
I took a fresh look around calmly as she told me this, and I noticed an overabundance of not just beautiful women but handsome lady killers as well.
Don't tell me that more than half of the people on this beach aren't humans... but demons...?
The males and females had been boldly exposing their skin, but with an air of dreariness.
See, Aina! I wasn't just imagining there being a lot of beautiful women, was I!? Who's the closet perv now!?
Well, even if that's the case, it doesn't change the fact that yer always lookin' at stuff like that, now does it!?
Ehehe♪ You two get along well♪
But does that mean... we're gonna get our life force sucked out too?
Well, if you're here as a couple, I don't think there's anything to worry about!
Oh no-no-no, we ain't a couple!
Metier's face became serious as she soothed Aina, who denied it with all her might.
Oh, but one word of advice. Please be absolutely sure not to eat anything on this island.
The food served on this island is filled with our demon qi to boost human arousal.
Once it circulates through your body, you'll no longer be able to stop your arousal, and you'll be sucked dry of all your vitality as a delicious meal.
S-, so the ones who went missing were...
They must have completely run out of vitality once they had the demon qi, poor things.
Metier let out a puff of breath in a sigh. From behind her, figures suddenly appeared.
Is that man a favorite of yours?
It was a man and woman with horns and wings. They must have been sex demons similar to Metier.
Agh...! No, he's not. This is the person who helped bring Lilim back...
You're as naive as ever, feeling indebted to a human for something as trivial as that♪
Metier shrank back and turned her gaze downward upon being mocked by the two, who seemed to be her seniors.
The demon qi has already entered your bodies.
The Incubus pointed a pale white hand at me and Aina in turn.
Huh!? But we didn't eat anythin'!
The shaved ice. You were covered in it, yes? It immediately melted, and the demon qi should have been absorbed into your skin by now.
(That damned Lilim... I'll never forgive her!!!)
